name: The Wood Remembers
summary: The wood takes back one child and returns another: a greater one from memory, a smaller one from the deep.

face.name: The Wood Remembers

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: Put an Entity you control into your Retire Zone, even if it is in Stasis. Then choose one: put onto your Front an Entity from your Retire Zone whose Flux cost is exactly 1 higher than that of the Entity put into the Retire Zone this way; or search your deck for an Entity whose Flux cost is exactly 1 lower, put it onto your Front, then shuffle your deck.

face.flavor: Every tree is a name. Every name returns, sooner or later.
